headline: Why Keysight Technologies (KEYS) Is Up 6.9% After EV And Renewable Testing Demand Outlook Improves - And What's Next
summary: Recently released industry research indicates that the global power device analyzer market is expected to grow as electric vehicles, renewable energy systems, semiconductor production, and advanced industrial electronics expand, with combined AC/DC analyzers and automotive customers emerging as key demand drivers.
